title: Choose Holdfast's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Triage Board. Keep it, take my pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Triage Board
options.lineage: emergency triage tags and the charge-nurse board
options.thesis: Every morning your accounts arrive triaged: tagged, sequenced and ready to call.
materials: perforated tag stock with tear-off colour bars
options.viewport: A deep surgical-teal field with one oversized triage tag hanging in 3D from its wire, tilting with the cursor, its red bar torn halfway; headline and the sign-up action set on the tag's own face; a moving strip of real tags (synthetic accounts) sliding underneath.
options.risk: Medical framing turns grim if it says patients; it must stay accounts, triage and calls.

raised.raise: Every section runs an attract loop: the product demonstrates itself (tags printing, scores settling) before the visitor commits.
Density courage: each tag carries real dense data (rank, risk, what stands out, playbook citation) set tight, never a sparse icon card.
One pull deploys the page: tearing the hero tag's strip unfolds Nemotron's brief below it.

options.label: The Daily Brief
options.thesis: Nemotron hands you the morning brief: checked, stamped, and redacted wherever the evidence ran out.
materials: kraft folder and cool bond paper
options.viewport: A folder opening on today's brief: headline, accounts to call first, one line visibly redacted by the verifier, and a stamped 'Sign up' action.
options.risk: The most familiar idea here: briefing and dossier metaphors are common in AI products, and redaction can read as secrecy.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: Holdfast as a broadcast service: every account a three-digit page, REVEAL shows why.
options.viewport: P100 index: today's accounts as numbered rows, live risk in cyan, alerts in red, REVEAL keyed for the reasons.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: REVEAL maps onto 'why this account' and pages onto accounts; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads as retro novelty to a CS lead unless the grid is strict.

options.label: Arcade Marquee Row
options.thesis: Each feature a lit cabinet down a dark aisle.
options.viewport: A dark aisle of glowing feature cabinets.
options.case: Fuses poorly: CS leads don't identify with arcades, and neon glow fights trust.
options.kept: Attract loops: show the product working before the visitor commits.
options.risk: Neon glow is the AI-slop default.

options.label: Designers Republic Sleeve
options.thesis: Hostile-brand information noise as immaculate branding.
options.viewport: One shouting word through a field of marks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: noise works against 'calm and checked'.
options.kept: Density courage: real dense data set tight.
options.risk: Hostile to a buyer who wants calm.

options.label: Miura-fold Sheet
options.thesis: One pull deploys a whole field.
options.viewport: A packet unfolding into a tessellated sheet.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the audience has no link to aerospace folds.
options.kept: One action propagates across the whole surface.
options.risk: Becomes a demo of origami, not the product.

options.label: HyperCard Stack
options.thesis: Accounts as a linked stack of one-bit cards.
options.viewport: A black-and-white card with painted buttons.
options.case: Fuses poorly: one-bit nostalgia undercuts a modern AI product.
options.kept: Every card addressable; back retraces your trail.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.thesis: Customers drifting toward an event horizon.
options.viewport: A glowing disk with one account slipping past the horizon.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dramatic, but says 'space AI', not retention.
options.kept: A held, empty centre that everything orbits.
options.risk: Space-black glow is the category's AI default.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished CRM-style SaaS site in the vein of Attio and Linear, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, sign-up button and a big product screenshot, then feature rows.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
